## Outcome

What does this change let a doctor, learner, or researcher accomplish?

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_public_release.py`
- [ ] Python source compiles.
- [ ] Shell launchers pass `bash -n`.
- [ ] Relevant Isaac task was exercised, or the reason it was not needed is documented.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Simulation-only boundary is preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, patient data, generated data, checkpoints, or machine-specific paths are included.
- [ ] ORBIT-Surgical attribution and third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] Runtime, data-format, and UI compatibility effects are explained below.
